top_visible_comments.comment: Satya Nadella there's a lot riding on it for Microsoft's future. Windows 11 has completely removed a lot of control from the user and you've made arbitrary decisions. You've taken control away from the end user and administrator and that is unacceptable. In Windows 12 you better return all the control back to the end user and administrator. Not everyone wants to use your AI stuff. Otherwise, you're going to have a massive amount of people move away from your operating system somewhere else: Linux But I've heard the will follow him. Maybe released: 🚀 Windows 12 ( "Agentic OS"): Rumors point to a June launch in San Francisco. We’re moving beyond chat; OS will likely empower AI agents to execute tasks across apps autonomously (e.g., managing files/data without manual input). 🛡️ Windows Resiliency: Expect a major shift in security architecture. Microsoft is moving third-party security tools out of the kernel to prevent system-wide crashes (no more BSOD outages!). 💼 M365 E7 Tier: A potential new subscription for "Agent 365" to help enterprises manage and govern their "digital workers" alongside human employees. 🛠️ Azure AI Foundry: New tools for developers to build multi-agent "swarms" that collaborate on complex workflows.
